name: Ryan Seacrest
current_role: Host of Wheel of Fortune (since Sept 2024); host of American Idol and Dick Clark's New Year's Rockin' Eve; founder, Ryan Seacrest Productions
profile: Atlanta-born TV/radio host and producer. Rose to fame hosting American Idol from 2002, built Ryan Seacrest Productions (Keeping Up with the Kardashians, Jamie Oliver's Food Revolution), co-hosted Live with Kelly and Ryan (2017-23) and replaced Pat Sajak as Wheel of Fortune host in 2024. Also investor in Typo keyboard and Pathwater.
interesting_fact: His Ryan Seacrest Foundation (launched 2010) builds 'Seacrest Studios' broadcast media centers inside children's hospitals - fourteen so far, from Atlanta to Utah.
deep_cut_fact: At 16 he won an internship at Atlanta's WSTR, where Tom Sullivan trained him; when a regular DJ called in sick, Sullivan put him on air - his first broadcast - and he then got the weekend overnight shift.
notes: Media personality rather than an energy/tech entrepreneur; foundation contact form is the published route. Also an investor in Pathwater (refillable aluminum-bottle water).

name: Lady Annabel Goldsmith
profile: English socialite and author, eponym of Annabel's nightclub in Mayfair; died 18 October 2025 (born 11 June 1934).
notes: Deceased 18 Oct 2025 per Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lady_Annabel_Goldsmith). Rich-list entry was shared with her son Lord (Zac) Goldsmith. Rest skipped per instructions.

name: Sun Taoran
current_role: Founder and major shareholder of Lakala Payment (300773.SZ); founded it in 2005 as chairman and president
profile: Peking University economics graduate (1991) and serial entrepreneur: co-founded BlueFocus (China's first listed PR firm) in 1996, led the launch of the Business Pocket (商务通) PDA at Hengji Weiye, then founded payments firm Lakala in 2005 with Lenovo and Lei Jun as backers. Lakala is now pushing an 'AI First' strategy and a planned Hong Kong H-share listing.
interesting_fact: As VP of Hengji Weiye from 1998 he led the launch of the 商务通 handheld, which reportedly held over 70% of China's PDA market in 1999-2001.
deep_cut_fact: After graduating from Peking University in 1991 he turned down his state-assigned job, joined Sida Group, rose from deputy manager of its ad department to GM of Sida Advertising within three years, and ran the computer magazine 《电脑时代周刊》 with a newspaper.

public_contacts.value: https://ir.p5w.net (Lakala investor interaction platform, used for its earnings calls)

notes: Lakala's 2026 IR events were fronted by director/GM Wang Guoqiang and board secretary Tang Hui, not Sun; his exact current board title was not confirmed. contact@lakala.com is the company mailbox listed in the 2024 annual report.

name: Shirley Hill
current_role: Founder of InterArch, the architecture and branding firm behind Commerce Bank and Metro Bank's branch design (wife of Metro Bank founder Vernon Hill)
profile: Founder of InterArch, the design and branding firm responsible for the look of Commerce Bank (US) and Metro Bank (UK), both founded by her husband Vernon Hill. Listed jointly with him on the Sunday Times Rich List (finance). Metro Bank moved its design work to other suppliers by end-2020.
interesting_fact: InterArch created the branding for both Commerce Bank and Metro Bank, the 'retail-style' banks known for long hours and in-person 'stores'.
deep_cut_fact: The Hills gave $10 million for the Vernon and Shirley Hill Pavilion at the University of Pennsylvania School of Veterinary Medicine; their foundation is one of the largest supporters of veterinary causes.
notes: No independent profile or published contact found; no recent source on her status, so alive marked unknown. Best route is likely via Vernon Hill's business offices. Avoid the InterArch/Metro related-party contract topic (governance controversy).

name: Zhou Shaoning (Shao-Ning Johnny Chou)
current_role: Founder, chairman and CEO of BEST Inc. (Hangzhou logistics group), taken private in March 2025 by a consortium including him
profile: Telecom and tech veteran who founded Hangzhou-based supply-chain and express-delivery group BEST Inc. in 2007 after running Google's Greater China business (2005-06) and UTStarcom China (1996-2005). BEST listed on the NYSE in 2017 and was taken private in March 2025 by a buyer group led by Chou.
interesting_fact: Before founding BEST he was Google's global VP and Greater China president, responsible for its sales and marketing in the region in 2005-2006.
deep_cut_fact: He spent a decade (1986-96) as director of wireless software and system development at AT&T Bell Laboratories, after studying computer science at Fudan (1978-80) and earning degrees from City College of New York, Princeton (MS engineering science) and Rutgers (MBA).
notes: Rich list name 'Zhou Shaoning' = Johnny Chou of BEST (百世). BEST went private 7 Mar 2025 (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/best-inc-announces-completion-of-going-private-transaction-302395536.html), so the IR mailbox may no longer be monitored. Strong fit for a logistics/tech angle.

name: Wu Xiong
current_role: Listed as director of Biostime Pharmaceuticals (China) Ltd. and general manager of Hainan Fangsheng Industry Development Co. (per MarketScreener); former non-executive director of Health and Happiness (H&H) International Holdings (HK:1112)
profile: Early shareholder in the Biostime (合生元) infant-nutrition business founded by Luo Fei, now Health and Happiness (H&H) International Holdings, listed in Hong Kong in 2010. Aggregator data show him as an H&H non-executive director from May 2010 to March 2018; earlier he was GM of Hainan Junjie Automobile Sale Co. (2000-09).
interesting_fact: Before his involvement with the Biostime baby-formula and probiotics group, aggregator data list him as general manager of a Hainan car dealership, Hainan Junjie Automobile Sale Co., from 2000 to 2009.
notes: Low public profile. The 2010 Biostime prospectus names a 吳熊 holding 26.0% of Biostime Pharmaceuticals alongside Luo Fei (28.15%) and Luo Yun; that is likely the same person but was not confirmed (https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2010/1203/ltn20101203042_c.pdf). Facts come from aggregator (MarketScreener) data only.

name: Yu Ziwen
current_role: Chairman and legal representative of Hunan Xiangjia Animal Husbandry (湘佳股份, 002982.SZ); stepped down as president in Sept 2026
profile: Hunan poultry entrepreneur who started out as an ordinary farmer raising chickens over 30 years ago and built Xiangjia into an integrated yellow-feathered broiler group (breeding, farming, slaughter, chilled meat, cold-chain, feed, organic fertilizer) based in Shimen county; listed in Shenzhen in 2020. He is a National People's Congress deputy and an actual controller of the company.
interesting_fact: In September 2026 he gave up the president title to focus on long-term strategy as chairman, handing day-to-day management to director and VP Zhao Kecheng; he holds about 45.08 million Xiangjia shares.
deep_cut_fact: Xiangjia's home base is Shimen county, Changde; it grew via a 'company + farmer' model to 700+ contract farmers by 2008 and is shifting to company-owned bases.
notes: Shared listing with Yu Weirong. As an NPC deputy he made proposals on edible-oil safety standards in March 2026 (reported by Securities Times, https://www.stcn.com/article/detail/3663830.html; not opened). Emails are from the 2024 annual report.

name: Guo Yongfang
current_role: Founder and >5% shareholder (about 12.7%) of Guotou Intelligence (国投智能, formerly Meiya Pico, 300188.SZ)
profile: Founder of Xiamen Meiya Pico (founded September 1999), which grew into a leading Chinese electronic-data-forensics and cybersecurity company and listed in Shenzhen in 2011. In 2019 she and other shareholders sold stakes to state investor SDIC, which became the controlling shareholder; the company was renamed Guotou Intelligence in January 2024. She still held 109.56 million shares in Feb 2026.
interesting_fact: The company she founded is described as China's leading electronic-data-forensics firm; in 2021 it extended its blockchain virtual-currency forensics to NFTs.
notes: Female founder, low public profile. Holding confirmed in Feb 2026 share-reduction notice (https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202602101819860269_1.pdf), which says she is not a controlling shareholder. A same-name associate professor at Hebei University of Technology is a different person. IR email belongs to the company's board office.

name: Liu Yanguo
profile: Listed on Hurun China Rich List 2008-2013 (real estate/investments, company 'Ximeng'). No source found identifying the person or company.
notes: Three searches (Chinese name with Ximeng/熙盟/锡盟 variants, Hurun + real estate) returned nothing about this person. The company's Chinese name is unknown; 'Ximeng' could mean 锡盟 (Xilingol League, Inner Mongolia), but this is unverified. Dropped off the list after 2013.

name: Yuan Meng
profile: Listed on the 2020 Hurun China Rich List with RMB 2.9bn (rank 1,883) as one of nine people whose wealth comes from SF Holding (顺丰), the express-delivery group founded by Wang Wei. Role at SF not found.
interesting_fact: One of nine SF-linked people on the 2020 Hurun list, alongside founder Wang Wei.
notes: Low profile. No source found for Yuan Meng's role at SF (possibly an early partner/shareholder; unverified). SF's filings searched did not name this person.

name: Liu Dequn
profile: Listed on Hurun China 2010-2018 (IT; 'Morningstar Network Technology'), with wealth shared with Liu Xiaoqing. No source found identifying the person or company.
notes: Three searches (Chinese name + 晨星/网络 variants, Liu Xiaoqing) returned nothing on this person. The company's Chinese name is unknown. Do not confuse with NetDragon's Liu Dejian (刘德建).

name: Wang Cailiang
current_role: Co-shareholder of Kuka Group (顾家集团, now 杭州德烨嘉俊企业管理有限公司), the former controlling shareholder of Kuka Home (603816.SH)
profile: One of four shareholders, with Wang Huoxian, Gu Jiangsheng and Wang Liying, of Kuka Group, the Hangzhou holding company founded in December 2008 that controlled sofa and furniture maker Kuka Home until 2025. No individual profile found.
notes: The shareholder link comes from Jiemian (Oct 2024, https://www.jiemian.com/article/11826368.html). Control of Kuka Home passed to Yingfeng/He Jianfeng in Jan 2025, and the holding company entered restructuring in Oct 2025, so avoid that topic. Identity marked uncertain because no profile of him exists beyond the shareholder listing.

name: Luo Aiwen
current_role: Chairman and actual controller of IFE Elevators (快意电梯, 002774.SZ), Dongguan
profile: Female entrepreneur behind Dongguan-based elevator and escalator maker IFE Elevators (快意电梯), listed in Shenzhen. She directly holds about 17% of the company and controls it with affiliated vehicles (combined ~45% controlling stake held by Kuaiyi Equity Investment); she chairs the board.
interesting_fact: In June 2025 she chaired the board meeting at which IFE agreed to set up an investment and M&A fund of up to RMB 500m with Shenzhen Investment Holdings' Donghai Investment.
notes: 'Ife Elevators' = 快意电梯. Shareholding facts from the March 2025 shareholder notice (https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-03-11/1222759569.PDF). Search snippets say she co-founded the company in 1987 and holds Dongguan CPPCC and federation-of-commerce roles, but this was not verified in a source I opened.

name: Lin Lan
current_role: Chairman (since May 2025), general manager and legal representative of Fujian Chase Science (创识科技, 300941.SZ)
profile: Born 1973, a long-time Chase Science executive who rose through its systems-integration, network-security and financial-products divisions, served as board secretary and deputy GM, then became general manager and, in May 2025, chairman of the Fuzhou-based fintech/payments software firm. She is a co-actual controller with Zhang Gengsheng.
interesting_fact: Her career inside the company spanned marketing manager in systems integration, deputy GM of the network-security unit, and head of the financial-products division before she took the top job.
deep_cut_fact: She holds a master's degree from Nanjing University of Science and Technology and an EMBA from CEIBS (China Europe International Business School).
notes: Wealth shared with Zhang Gengsheng (co-controller), who stepped down as chairman in May 2025 and is subject to an investigation and court case, so avoid that topic. The IR mailbox is the securities office; the board secretary is Peng Hongyi.
